description: This file contains implementation of classes and functions related to GLSL shader variable types, including uniforms, varyings, interface blocks, and work group sizes, used in shader translation and validation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ShaderVariable
classes.description: Represents a GLSL shader variable, including uniforms, varyings, and attributes, with methods for comparison, size calculation, and name resolution.

classes.name: InterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents a GLSL interface block, including its fields, layout, and binding information, with methods for comparison and naming.

classes.name: WorkGroupSize
classes.description: Encapsulates the size of a compute shader work group, with validation and comparison methods.

methods.name: GetNonAuxiliaryInterpolationType
methods.description: Returns the non-auxiliary interpolation type, converting centroid to smooth.

methods.name: InterpolationTypesMatch
methods.description: Checks if two interpolation types match, considering auxiliary qualifiers.
